name: notebook-workbench
description: Inspect CSV, TSV, and Parquet data, safely edit Jupyter notebooks, and run reproducible analyses with durable evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Safely edit notebooks and run reproducible analyses.
interface.longDescription: Provides a deterministic local CLI and Codex workflows for inspecting CSV, TSV, and Parquet data, creating notebooks, editing cells by stable ID or tag, validating outputs, and managing reproducible iterative analyses with immutable requests, Papermill runs, and durable evidence.
defaultPrompt: List the cells and tags in this notebook.
Safely update a notebook cell by tag.
Inspect errors in this executed notebook.
Inspect this Parquet file and its grouped value frequencies.
Create a reproducible notebook analysis workspace.
Continue this analysis with a follow-up request and evidence-preserving run.
